result.instructions: Tools for Cerebras, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which models can I use on my Cerebras account right now?"; "Ask qwen-3.8-27b to summarise this paragraph in three bullet points."; "Show the details of the gpt-oss-120b model.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cerebras data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cerebras_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cerebras_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cerebras_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cerebras_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cerebras_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the models available to your Cerebras account (for example gpt-oss-120b, qwen-3.8-27b). Call this first, because model ids change. Cerebras API: GET /v1/models.

tools.name: cerebras_get_model
tools.title: Get a model
tools.description: Get one model by id: its id, object type, creation time and owner. Cerebras API: GET /v1/models/{model_id}.

model_id.description: The model id, for example qwen-3.8-27b (from cerebras_list_models).

tools.name: cerebras_chat_completion
tools.title: Chat completion
tools.description: Send a conversation to a Cerebras model and return its reply (the full API response: choices, message content, usage). Streaming is off. Output is model-generated text, not human-written. Each call uses tokens from your Cerebras limits. Cerebras API: POST /v1/chat/completions.

model.description: The model id, for example gpt-oss-120b (from cerebras_list_models).

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper limit on generated tokens, including reasoning tokens.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning depth. Supported values differ by model; leave empty for the model default.

prompts.title: Get started with Cerebras
prompts.description: What you can do with Cerebras here, with example requests to try.
